text: [70] pañcime bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattanti katame pañca idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattantīti . saññāvaggo dutiyo . tassuddānaṃ deva ca saññā deva vaḍḍhī ca sākacchena ca sājivaṃ iddhipādā ca deva vuttā nibbidā cāsavakkhayāti . _______________ yodhājīvavaggo tatiyo
